redfin.remarks: SOUTH OF THE BOULEVARD. 15,000+ SQ. FT. LOT. POOL & SPA . HOME THEATER . BASKETBALL COURT . VIEWS. Welcome to 4830 Winnetka Ave, an exceptional 5-bedroom, 3-bath retreat offering approximately 3,529 sq. ft. of beautifully reimagined living space and an incredible resort-style setting. Step inside to soaring vaulted ceilings, wide-plank oak flooring and a dramatic designer fireplace finished in Italian plaster and rift-cut white oak. The stunning custom white-oak kitchen features abundant cabinetry, premium JennAir appliances and an open layout flowing seamlessly into the living and dining spaces. Expansive sliding glass doors fill the home with natural light and create effortless indoor-outdoor living. Five spacious bedrooms include a serene primary suite overlooking the grounds with a beautifully designed spa-inspired bath. A dedicated home theater with surround sound provides the perfect space for movies, sports and entertaining. And then there's the backyard. Set on more than 15,000 sq. ft. , this private outdoor oasis features a sparkling pool, oversized 12-person wet-edge spa, cabana and BBQ area , firepit, outdoor sound system and Mamba basketball court, with multiple spaces to lounge, dine and entertain. Additional highlights include dual-zone HVAC, upgraded electrical and plumbing, smart-home features, custom wood detailing and extensive stone and concrete work. The entire property was extensively redesigned and remodeled in 2022-2023. Nearly 3,529 sq. ft. of living space. Over 15,000 sq. ft. of land. Incredible amenities. South of the Boulevard. This is the one you've been waiting for.
